messages:
emma: Kicking off POC for MediCare Inc. They won't allow PrivateLink; only VPC peering. Need a crisp peering runbook + quick TF snippet and notes about API key delivery over peered network. POC window: 10 days.

rafael: Runbook (high-level): 1) Confirm CIDR non-overlap. 2) Customer creates VPC peering request -> share peering id. 3) We accept the peering. 4) Both sides add routes for specific subnets to the peering attachment. 5) Update SGs to allow tcp/443 from peer subnets only. 6) Validate from their bastion host (curl).

zhi: Quick TF snippet (customer side) to create peer + route:```resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "peer" { vpc_id = var.vpc_id peer_vpc_id = var.redwood_vpc peer_owner_id = var.redwood_account } resource "aws_route" "to_redwood" { route_table_id = var.route_table_id destination_cidr_block = var.redwood_cidr vpc_peering_connection_id = aws_vpc_peering_connection.peer.id }```

rafael: Key delivery options: a) short-lived POC key (48h) uploaded to their vault via presigned S3 link; b) customer provides a vault integration (preferred); c) as last resort, 1Password share. We'll log issuance and attach audit-id to the ticket.

emma: Testing commands to give infra: `curl -v https://<control-plane-ip-or-dns>/health` from a bastion in their app subnet; expect 200 and cert CN match. If 403 -> check SG/route/ACL.

ops-bot: Ticket POC-6102 created. Owner: rafael. ETA: 2 business days to accept peering.

rafael: I'll set acceptance manual so we can review CIDRs and avoid accepting overlapping ranges. I'll post once peering is accepted and routes are added.
